name: qjs_free_cstring

ownership.argument: This is astrolink's qjs_free_cstring. .155 factored it differently: there the public FreeCString (0xc3b89f2, 20 bytes) forwards to QJS_FreeValue with (ptr-16, tag -7) and the decrement lives in that call; here the decrement is inlined. Same operation, different factoring, which is why the size differs (38 versus 20).

provenance.source: Takes the context and the string pointer, reads the runtime from ctx+16, decrements the reference count at ptr-16 and calls the internal __JS_FreeValue with tag -7 when it reaches zero. 21 call sites.
